factory-tui.text: factory-tui is a popup browser over the tmux windows on this host.
It does not replace tmux and it does not create windows.
You keep sessions and windows. The app reads their names, draws a tree, shows a snapshot, and jumps there.

today.text: One row is one tmux window. Panes stay inside that window.
The right-hand view is a snapshot. Opening the browser does not resize live windows.
Enter or a double-click jumps to the selected window.

not-yet-decided.text: The research pages sketch a flatter world. That experiment is not validated.
Today, use ordinary tmux plus the naming rules on the Using page.
